user.title: Set up VPD Air Auto
user.description: Automatically create VPDair, VPDleaf and absolute humidity sensors for each Home Assistant device that exposes both a temperature sensor and a humidity sensor.

data.display_name: Global VPDair sensor name (for example: VPDair or Air VPD)
data.leaf_offset: Global VPDleaf temperature offset in °C (for example: -2.0 means leaf = air - 2.0 °C)
data.leaf_display_name: Global VPDleaf sensor name (for example: VPDleaf or Leaf VPD)
data.absolute_humidity_icon: Global absolute humidity icon (for example: mdi:water)
data.absolute_humidity_display_name: Global absolute humidity sensor name (for example: Absolute Humidity)
data.dew_point_icon: Global dew point icon (for example: mdi:thermometer-water)
data.dew_point_display_name: Global dew point sensor name (for example: Dew Point)
